description: Run one of the Oasis Toolkit services by id with an input object. Pass the id as `service_id` (alias `service` is also accepted) and its params as `input`. Returns a uniform envelope {ok, data, meta:{method, provenance, …}, error}. Free, deterministic, no signup. Discover ids with aicom_list_services.

input.description: The service's input object (see aicom_describe_service for its shape)

service_id.description: The service id to run, e.g. 'json_repair'. Required unless you pass the alias `service`.

name: aicom_run_service
title: Run an Oasis service
